Those dates had not expired when the post appeared, but they concern different milestones from the claimed Q1 GPU target. limitations: The speaker's quotations cannot substitute for independent verification of the underlying reporting.
A broader construction schedule cannot disprove a missed, earlier GPU milestone.
Later delivery dates are not treated as direct evidence of spring 2025 status.
